entries.example_en: Orders went up in both the first and second quarters of 2026.
entries.example_zh: 2026 年前两个季度订单量都在上升。

entries.example_en: Margin went down in March, then recovered.
entries.example_zh: 毛利率三月下降，之后有所回升。

entries.example_en: Revenue shows steady growth, with only one small dip in April.
entries.example_zh: 营收稳步增长，只在四月小幅下降过一次。

entries.example_en: Orders bounced back in the fourth quarter.
entries.example_zh: 订单量在第四季度反弹。

entries.example_en: The highest point was in Q4 2026.
entries.example_zh: 最高点出现在 2026 年第四季度。

entries.example_en: The lowest point was in Q1 2025, at 38 million.
entries.example_zh: 最低点出现在 2025 年第一季度，为 3800 万单。

entries.example_en: Revenue reached a peak in June.
entries.example_zh: 营收在六月达到峰值。

entries.example_en: Sales bottomed out in February and then picked up.
entries.example_zh: 销售额二月触底，之后开始回升。

entries.example_en: Delivery takes about 18 minutes.
entries.example_zh: 配送大约需要 18 分钟。

entries.example_en: Roughly one in five new customers came from the mini program.
entries.example_zh: 大约每五个新客户里就有一个来自小程序。

entries.example_en: The mobile app's share was just over 50 percent of new customers.
entries.example_zh: 手机 App 的新客户占比略高于 50%。

entries.example_en: Orders nearly doubled from 38 to 74 million.
entries.example_zh: 订单量从 3800 万单增至 7400 万单，几乎翻了一倍。

entries.example_en: Compared with the first half, the second half was much higher.
entries.example_zh: 与上半段相比，下半段高得多。

entries.example_en: East China sold the most coffee of any region.
entries.example_zh: 华东的咖啡销量在各地区中最多。

entries.example_en: Coffee was ahead of bakery in every region.
entries.example_zh: 在每个地区，咖啡的销售额都领先于烘焙。

entries.example_en: The gap between East China and Northeast is 317 thousand yuan.
entries.example_zh: 华东与东北之间的差距是 31.7 万元。

entries.example_en: The mobile app accounts for 52 percent of new customers.
entries.example_zh: 手机 App 占新客户的 52%。

entries.example_en: Coffee makes up most of the sales.
entries.example_zh: 咖啡构成了销售额的大部分。

entries.example_en: The mini program brings in about a fifth of new customers.
entries.example_zh: 小程序带来了约五分之一的新客户。

entries.example_en: The mobile app now has a larger share than the mini program.
entries.example_zh: 手机 App 现在的份额比小程序更大。

entries.example_en: First, the customer places an order.
entries.example_zh: 首先，顾客下单。

entries.example_en: Then the restaurant starts preparing the food.
entries.example_zh: 然后商家开始备餐。

entries.example_en: Once the restaurant accepts the order, the rider can pick it up.
entries.example_zh: 商家一旦接单，骑手就可以去取餐。

entries.example_en: Finally, the customer confirms receipt in the app.
entries.example_zh: 最后，顾客在 App 里确认收货。
